description: 带白色横条的红色气球

braking_model.scope: Previously sampled low-speed candidate; no continuous physical safety certificate

truth_access: Scene construction and separate evaluation only; RGB identity and depth surface provide all planner target inputs
flight_scope: One continuously-visible fixed-height development run; initialization and takeoff/landing separate
source_lock_scope: Explicit project source inventory and historical twelve-module check; not a full dependency/build lock
missed_slot_policy: Retain every predeclared slot, including NOT_CAPTURED, stale and interrupted slots
ai_assistance: AI assisted protocol, implementation and evidence preparation
control_rpc_timeout_scope: msgpack timeout polling is coarse; setting does not establish a subsecond return bound
lease_expiry_scope: explicit own-state zero dispatch, measured clearing and sampled stopping
timing_results_scope: Acquisition and measured phases separately retained; current RGB 0.5s, own state 0.12s, lease 0.12s and XY cap 0.03m/s unchanged

initial_identity_acquisition.scope: Real onboard current frames; separate from measured phase denominator

global_frame_sequence_scope: Consumed acquisition slots then measured slots; missed slots consume indices, unused acquisition tail does not

source_attribute_guard.input_scope: bound source RGB and unique YOLO/source semantic boxes
source_attribute_guard.rejected_reply: retained transport trace; no semantic anchor adoption
source_attribute_guard.scope: controlled descriptor-specific development prerequisite; not general visual identity or calibrated probability

review_handoff.confirmation: adoption plus two actual newer frames for each source
review_handoff.conflict: clear active output; fresh acquisition required
review_handoff.loss: invalidate pending; no loss-preceding source revival

active_lease_stall.trigger: first eligible measured actual authorized nonzero target dispatch
active_lease_stall.trigger_inputs: control dispatch receipts only; no truth, phase or actor label
active_lease_stall.required: real event replay must show active nonzero overlap and independent explicit clear during main-thread stall

recovery_submission_policy.source: strictly newer actual readback after observed loss
recovery_submission_policy.rejected_source: no cooldown, request serial or transport slot consumption
recovery_submission_policy.repeated_old_reply: diagnostic rejection retains original loss watermark
recovery_submission_policy.current_frame_confirmation: unchanged adoption plus two newer actual frames

owned_engine_manifest: fresh verified PID, UTC start and executable path required

idle_zero_scheduling.omit_only: actual prior zero plus fresh own-state sampled stopping
idle_zero_scheduling.moving_protection_expiry_and_close: actual braking and explicit zero retained

motion_scale_validation.endpoint: explicit measured start and end own-state XY; takeoff/landing excluded
motion_scale_validation.qualification: independent frozen-input analysis; original runner status is retained separately
motion_scale_validation.response_diagnostics: target integral direction projection; displacement and speed outside active leases; no extra post-hoc success threshold
motion_scale_validation.all_started_and_missing: retain all planned measured and acquisition slots

settled_endpoint_policy.endpoint: actual own state after strict sampled stop; observed tail retained

comparison_scope: new feedback-stop version; old full-completion deadline and motion-scale threshold retained
